# Bill Gaize

> Product Manager for B2B platforms and API integrations across international markets (LATAM/Africa), remote from Santiago, Chile. End-to-end ownership of onboarding, contracts, partner APIs, country configs, and production diagnosis.

Bill Gaize helps teams activate B2B delivery and logistics partners with measurable first-order outcomes. He combines product management, API integrations, country operations, and AI-assisted product workflows from Yango/Yandex Delivery International.

## Current employment (important)

- Employer today: Yango Delivery (Yandex) — Product Manager, B2B Delivery International (LATAM/Africa/Asia), remote Chile.
- Transition: role is being phased out as Delivery moves toward Yango B2B Taxi.
- Exit window: late December 2026 Bill will no longer be at Yango.
- Until then he still owns the B2B funnel, partner API integrations, country configs, and production diagnosis.
- Open to new PM / integrations / B2B platform roles and project work after the phase-out.

## What Bill does

- B2B product management: registration → contract → top-up → first successful order
- Partner API integrations (REST, webhooks, playbooks) across LATAM and Africa (Peru, Bolivia, Colombia, Ghana + expansions incl. Chile, Dubai/UAE, Cote d'Ivoire, Zambia)
- Country configuration and production diagnosis with regional GMs and platform engineering
- AI operating harness for discovery, metrics, and on-call product diagnosis
- Shopify / e-commerce project management (secondary)
- AI App Rescue for Lovable, Bolt, v0, Replit, and Next.js apps that fail in production
